description: Generate fixtures/cases.json for the CANDIDATE Wispral contracts.

cases.name: G-ENV-1_desktop_without_os_session
cases.invariant: desktop principal binds the OS session

cases.name: G-ENV-2_tenant_without_channel
cases.invariant: tenant principal binds account and channel

cases.name: G-ENV-4_render_without_consent_epoch
cases.invariant: render events carry the consent epoch

cases.name: G-ENV-5_worker_without_digest
cases.invariant: worker events carry the artifact digest

cases.name: invalid_free_text_policy_version
cases.invariant: policy version is a digest or name@semver

cases.name: G-CAN-1b_crash_exit_releases_lease
cases.invariant: owner-observed exit after a crash releases the lease

cases.name: invalid_observed_stop_by_deadline
cases.invariant: a deadline expiry is not an observed stop

cases.name: G-CAN-3_unknown_effect_without_intent
cases.invariant: an unknown effect names its reconcile intent

cases.name: invalid_terminal_without_response
cases.invariant: every cancelled request gets exactly one response

cases.name: invalid_admitted_unknown_commercial
cases.invariant: an admitted model has a resolved commercial status

cases.name: invalid_personal_display_name
cases.invariant: no personal display data in the contract

cases.name: G-POL-3_undecidable_enforced
cases.invariant: UNDECIDABLE is never the enforced decision

cases.name: G-POL-2_text_delivery_confidence_only
cases.invariant: text delivery needs a rule and a target binding

cases.name: invalid_layer_widening
cases.invariant: layers only narrow and compose to the candidate

cases.name: invalid_rewrite_without_parent
cases.invariant: derived text points at its parent

cases.name: invalid_partial_zero
cases.invariant: partial delivers at least one character

cases.name: G-DEL-3_restored_unused_clipboard
cases.invariant: an unused clipboard is not restored

cases.name: invalid_stale_epoch_delivered
cases.invariant: a stale activation epoch must be refused

cases.name: invalid_unknown_without_probe
cases.invariant: unknown outcomes need a reconcile probe

cases.name: invalid_result_without_reconciled
cases.invariant: a reconcile result implies the reconciled state

cases.name: invalid_text_delivery_not_an_intent
cases.invariant: text delivery is a delivery_outcome, not an effect intent

cases.name: invalid_studio_money
cases.invariant: the export owner only commits files

cases.name: invalid_active_speaker_not_checked
cases.invariant: active personal consent requires a speaker match

cases.name: invalid_missing_reference_digest
cases.invariant: consent binds the exact reference audio

cases.name: invalid_ask_confirmed_by_conversation_text
cases.invariant: conversation text never confirms an ASK

cases.name: invalid_self_asserted_stock_voice
cases.invariant: stock voices come from a catalog, not a flag

cases.name: invalid_admitted_remote_code
cases.invariant: admitted models never run remote code

cases.name: invalid_untyped_delivery_payload
cases.invariant: contract-bearing events carry their contract payload

cases.name: invalid_delivered_into_password_field
cases.invariant: never deliver into a password field

cases.name: invalid_delivered_into_read_only_field
cases.invariant: never deliver into a read-only field

cases.name: invalid_delivered_focus_not_revalidated
cases.invariant: same-window focus moves are caught before delivery

cases.name: invalid_active_statement_mismatch
cases.invariant: the statement must say the consent script

cases.name: invalid_active_operator_not_confirmed
cases.invariant: a human operator confirms the statement

cases.name: invalid_statement_without_challenge
cases.invariant: a capture-time challenge defeats replayed or spliced statements

cases.name: invalid_commercial_operator_key
cases.invariant: commercial consent needs the consent-service key

cases.name: invalid_written_consent_method
cases.invariant: only live identity checks with a live statement

cases.name: invalid_signature_key_differs_from_issuer
cases.invariant: the signing key is the issuer key

cases.name: invalid_purposes_widened_after_attestation
cases.invariant: attested fields cannot change after signing

cases.name: invalid_reference_swapped_after_attestation
cases.invariant: the attested reference audio cannot be swapped

cases.name: invalid_broker_intent_without_capability
cases.invariant: consequential broker calls need a capability

cases.name: invalid_capability_tool_substituted
cases.invariant: the capability binds the exact tool

cases.name: invalid_capability_args_substituted
cases.invariant: the capability binds the exact arguments

bundles.name: invalid_duplicate_open_intent_same_key
bundles.invariant: one non-terminal intent per (principal, owner, key)

bundles.name: invalid_intent_verdict_class_mismatch
bundles.invariant: verdict class must match the intent

bundles.name: invalid_capability_nonce_replayed
bundles.invariant: a capability nonce is consumed on first use
